name: Planar Volatility
body:
Prerequisite(s): Elemental, outsider or extraplanar subtype, pool of providence class feature; astride the ladder or archon teleportation providence, Translocation Sensitivity, Knowledge (planar) 13 ranks, Base Attack Bonus +13, Cha

Benefit(s): You scramble the planar connections in your immediate area. As an immediate action you can expend a point of providence when any creature attempts to use a conjuration (summoning) or conjuration (teleportation) spell, you can attempt to counterspell it as if you had cast dispel magic.
